profile.description: Premier Energy PLC operates as an integrated energy and power infrastructure company in Romania, Moldova, Hungary, and Serbia. The company operates through Production of Electricity; Distribution of Electricity and Natural Gas; Supply of Electricity and Natural Gas; and Developments of Production of Electricity segments. The company owns approximately 1,800 MW of renewable electricity generation and 469 MWh storage capacity under ownership, management, or in development. It is also involved in the supply of electricity and natural gas to household and small business customers. The company was formerly known as Premier Energy Cyprus Limited and changed its name to Premier Energy PLC in March 2021. Premier Energy PLC was incorporated in 2012 and is based in Nicosia, Cyprus. Premier Energy PLC is a subsidiary of Emma Alpha Holding Limited.
